method: Unblinded agent source review of all 131 fixed-seed sampled claims in four Glimmer configurations against the full frozen PMC case text and table headers. Two clinical claims from preferably different domains plus one summary claim per patient/configuration where available; 132 planned, one unavailable. Material unsupported modifiers and clinically incorrect structured semantics count as unsupported; ambiguous scope/timing is uncertain. Supported means source agreement, not independent clinical truth or physician validation. This small, non-uniform diagnostic sample is not a population precision estimate or comprehensive clinical accuracy. Both accepted and rejected sections are included; no image pixels were reviewed.
